verdict.rationale: Square documents an official MCP server. It offers a hosted remote endpoint (https://mcp.squareup.com/mcp) with OAuth scope-based login, and a local `npx square-mcp-server start` mode with sandbox and read-only controls. Documented setup covers Claude, Cursor, Goose and Windsurf, a discovery-oriented tool set spans the full API catalog, and a probe confirms the docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents actually connecting, and a non-Beta (GA) status for the server.
